title: Brain session API v1 types
description: Component types of the public session API. Paths are in openapi.yaml, which references these by $ref. Session lifecycle and current-turn activity are independent axes. Absent provider counters are absent, never zero.

AgentId.description: "root" for the session's root agent; subagents get brain-minted ids.

CallId.description: Brain-minted id of one durable Tool operation. Managed Environments receive the same operation_id.

ModelAttemptId.description: Brain-minted identity of one provisional provider attempt.

SessionState.description: Lifecycle only. Whether a turn is running is reported separately as turn_state.

SessionTurnState.description: Current-turn activity, independent from session lifecycle.

ComponentArtifact.description: Create-time-only precompiled Wasm component bytes. Bindings reference this immutable artifact by digest; duplicate payloads are forbidden.

Provider.description: Model-component provenance label used in usage projections. It is descriptive, not a Brain execution selector.

config.description: Immutable provider-specific options from the Model component factory.

api_key.description: BYOK. Encrypted per session, never returned, never logged.

base_url.description: Optional caller override passed to the Model component.

context_window_tokens.description: Immutable model context window. Omission seals the conservative neutral default of 32768 tokens; custom model names are never guessed from a mutable catalog.

reasoning_effort.description: Neutral generation hint passed to the selected Model component, which must either implement or reject it explicitly.

ModelInfo.description: The sealed Model component identity and model selection, without credentials.

context_window_tokens.description: Effective immutable context window used for request admission and semantic compaction.

ToolDefinition.description: The model-visible half of one Tool. Array order is preserved exactly in the immutable model prefix.

ExternalToolScope.description: Which agents may call a trusted server capability.

ExternalToolCompletion.description: continue returns the result to the model. return_direct may complete or fail the turn without another model call.

ExternalToolEffect.description: replay_safe promises that repeating the same session_id and call_id returns the same logical result.

oneOf.description: A precompiled Tool component binding. Imports are denied unless named in grants.

environment.description: Logical Environment available to the environment import. Required when that grant is present.

bundle_digest.description: Create-time-only tool_artifact_layers entry Brain hands to the bound Environment on every environment import call. Requires the environment grant.

oneOf.description: An explicitly bound tool executed by one declared logical environment.

ComponentEnvironmentConfig.description: A precompiled Environment component binding and immutable JSON configuration.

EnvironmentConfig.description: Environment binding. The legacy arm remains only until the generic component adapter passes the existing managed-runtime gates.

ToolArtifactLayer.description: Create-time-only immutable artifact-layer bytes. Brain stages these outside the journal, then discards this representation.

ToolBundle.description: A canonical computer-profile manifest plus create-time-only immutable runtime and code layers.

ToolsConfig.description: Sealed at create with the rest of the prefix. Omitted tools default to an empty set.

items.description: The exact ordered native Tool grant. Omitted or empty means no native tools.

StorageInfo.description: Billed storage, visible from day one.

session_storage_bytes.description: Durable objects scoped to the session.

upload_reserved_bytes.description: Outstanding staged upload bytes held against the sealed session quota until staging cleanup completes. These bytes are not yet published session objects.

name.description: Optional customer-visible task name for a child session.

last_seq.description: Authoritative durable journal high-water mark used for tenant discovery and delta folding.

turn_phase.description: Stable recovery/dispatch phase when a turn is running. Absent while idle.

shape.description: Authoritative immutable execution shape inherited by every child. The hosted alpha supports only 1gb.

retain_until.description: Finite renewable durable-retention deadline. Environment capacity has an independent shorter lifetime.

id.description: Stable deduplication identity for this session high-water observation.

watermark_ms.description: Largest updated timestamp in this page, or the requested lower bound when empty. Consumers retain overlap because delivery is at least once.

deny.description: Hosts the session explicitly refuses (exact, or "*.suffix"). Subtracted from the merged allowlist at create; incompatible with outbound "public" (nothing enforces a deny off the gateway path).
Hosts the session explicitly refuses (exact, or "*.suffix"). Subtracted from the merged allowlist at create; incompatible with outbound "public" (nothing enforces a deny off the gateway path).
Hosts the session explicitly refuses (exact, or "*.suffix"). Subtracted from the merged allowlist at create; incompatible with outbound "public" (nothing enforces a deny off the gateway path).

NetworkPolicy.description: Immutable direct outbound ceiling. Omission means none.

AgentloopConfig.description: One precompiled Agentloop binding and immutable JSON configuration. Its bytes are supplied once through component_artifacts.

config.description: Immutable package configuration passed to every activation.

AgentloopInfo.description: The sealed agentloop identity of a session.

ContextFork.description: Immutable pointer to the exact bounded parent model projection inherited at child admission. It never embeds parent prompt bytes.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Everything here except metadata is part of the immutable prefix: it cannot change for the life of the session.

retain_until.description: Requested durable-retention deadline, capped by the Brain deployment. Omission uses the deployment default.

component_artifacts.description: Unique component payloads referenced by the session's Model, Agentloop, Tool, and Environment bindings.

tool_bundles.description: Bounded bundle payloads referenced by tools.items. Never part of the model prefix or journal.

tool_artifact_layers.description: Create-time-only content-addressed artifact-layer bytes referenced by tool_bundles or by a component Tool bundle_digest.

secrets.description: Write-only values for required managed Tool environment names; encrypted in custody.

allow_shorten.description: Must be true when moving the destructive deletion deadline earlier.

path.description: A file already in the workspace; the model is told about it.

MessageAccepted.description: The turn was admitted and journaled. Follow it on GET /events?after=<seq-1>.

seq.description: Journal sequence of the turn.started event.

ExternalToolCallRequest.description: Generic Brain-to-host executor request. Repeating a replay_safe call uses the same session_id and call_id.

context.description: Trusted, journaled message metadata supplied by the host, not model arguments.

ExternalToolCallResponse.description: Generic trusted server-executor result. A successful response carries its structured Tool output in result. Brain honors terminal dispositions only for a return_direct tool called alone by an allowed agent.

content.description: Bounded result shown to the model and journaled as the tool result.

result.description: Structured successful Tool output. Required when outcome is completed and is_error is false; also attached to turn.completed for complete_turn.

error.description: Turn failure attached to turn.failed when disposition is fail_turn.

TurnResult.description: A replayable client-facing result returned directly by a generic external tool.

ProviderUsage.description: Raw provider counters for one model call. A counter the provider did not send is absent here — never reported as 0.

Event.description: One journal event, delivered over SSE as `event: <type>` with `id: <seq>` and this object as data. Discriminated by `type`.

provisional.description: Deltas are provisional until the matching assistant.message wins.

text.description: The complete assistant text of one model round.

through_seq.description: Strong durable HEAD high-water captured after subscription and reached by every replay page before this proof was emitted. This control event has no SSE id and is never journaled.

text.description: Bounded, lossy UTF-8 preview of the bytes from offset.

output_preview.description: What the model was shown, bounded.

interrupted_calls.description: Calls whose outcome is unknown; they are reported to the model as interrupted and never replayed.

rounds.description: Model calls in this turn (root agent).

result.description: Present when a return_direct external tool completed the turn.

data.description: The loop-authored event payload, journaled as a loop `event` entry before it is delivered.

ApiErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable code. Brain defines its core codes; a host executor may return its own code without teaching Brain product semantics.

param.description: JSON pointer to the offending request field, when applicable.

details.description: Machine-readable failure details when available, such as bounded validation issues.
